source: ATLAS arXiv:1605.03814, SR 2jl counting control, n=263, b=283 +/-24, luminosity 3.2 fb^-1; inputs retained in evidence/audits/2026-09-09-comparative-pilot
assumptions: Single-bin approximation with a gamma/Poisson background constraint; not the full experimental likelihood.
Unit signal means the POI counts signal events. Divide by 3.2 fb^-1 only for visible cross section.
Asymptotic qtilde CLs; expected bands use the conditional background-only Asimov convention. Toy coverage remains unvalidated.
